title: Item E41 sub10 re-read of the Earnings21+ConEC system form: descriptive structural read against the sealed E35 direct arm, bound per window
cell_kind: DESCRIPTIVE STRUCTURAL READ below every power floor (n = 10 calls, 342 windows); stage3_measurement form-proof, claims_benefit false.

authority.item: E41, rows 103 and 158; row 98 (the Earnings full-discovery calibration n >= 400 stays after the SLURP main line)
authority.attribution_method: docs/results/2026-09-22-e21-native-window-e35-sub10-diagnosis.md section 0 ('Attribution method and its validation') and sections 1-5

gate_before_any_read: The E41 dry-run read holds R1-R3 and is committed BEFORE this cell is flipped; this read starts only after the single attempt's manifest is sealed COMPLETE.
claim_boundary: No effectiveness, superiority, generalization, admission or paper claim. WER is reported as the carrier's standard scorer, not as the agentic task; entity and numeric metrics are reported beside it. Every number is descriptive and development-grade (decisions 28, 86).

contacts.scorer: the ONE complete scoring job the flight's finalize runs over the complete manifest; the read itself runs none

direct.role: the bare-core comparator, bound per window by execution_unit_id; its sealed scores are read, never re-scored

e35_system.role: the same six-node form BEFORE v3.1 and E41 (episode scope, cap 1,024, Reviewer probe v1, Perception note v1): the structural contrast

structural_readings.statement: windows whose terminal_disposition names perception or reviewer with an abstention: TARGET ZERO (R1 at scale; E35 sealed 75 + 1)
windows delivering the empty string (delivery_text_sha256 = e3b0c442...): TARGET ZERO beyond the direct arm's own count (E35 system 76, E35 direct 1)

the Perception truncation rate (finish_reason 'length' at 640 over 342 Perception contacts): TARGET ZERO, reported with its count; the Reviewer truncation count beside it (E35 sealed Perception 75 / 342 and Reviewer 30 / 428 at 1,024)

contacts per window, role visits, Planner routes, byte-identical second Solver drafts, terminal reasons (finite_completion / revision_limit / none), against the E35 system arm's 4.67 contacts per window

Perception note compliance with the E41 bound over the 342 sealed notes, counted with scripts/analysis/e21_e41_perception_note_trace_read.py's feature code (lines, words per line, repetition share, window-transcript re-emission against the bound direct arm): counts only

scores_reported_descriptively.from: the sealed E41 arm's own scores.json (one complete job) beside the sealed E35 direct arm's scores.json (never re-scored)
scores_reported_descriptively.carrier_standard_scorer: asr-wer-whisper: corpus WER, S / D / I, per-call WER (Whisper-normalised, beside saea-scoring-v1)
agentic_metrics: conec-entity-wer-official: per-entity-class WER (PERSON first, ORG, GPE, PRODUCT) -- a DEFINITION MIRROR of fstalign RecordTagWer with official_tool_run false; the official ConEC tool (revdotcom/fstalign, a C++/OpenFST binary) is NOT installed or runnable in this repository and is not run for this read; the label 'mirror' travels with every number
numeric-value-accuracy-v1: accuracy, expected / matched / spurious numeric words, by kind
semantic-high-impact-error-rate-v1: rate (advisory: the taxonomy's only HIGH trigger is negation)

per_window_attribution.method: exactly the E35 diagnosis's: reference tokens via data.references.reference_tokens + reproduction.asr_wer_whisper.normalize_whisper_english (the sealed scorer's own normaliser); alignment path from rapidfuzz.distance.Levenshtein.opcodes; the reference partition into windows taken ONCE from the DIRECT arm's alignment and reused for both arms, so per-window deltas are on identical reference spans
per_window_attribution.validation: the recomputed edit distance per call must equal the sealed per-call edit distance on both arms (10 / 10) before any per-window number is reported; a mismatch stops the read
tables: delivered-token / reference-word ratio per window, bucketed (0, < 0.25, 0.25-0.75, 0.75-1.25, >= 1.25), both arms
per-window extra error mass (E41 errors minus direct errors on the same span): windows carrying 50 / 80 / 90 % of the positive mass and their delivery sources
by delivery source (accepted Solver / terminal Solver / abstention), by terminal reason, by contacts per window: windows, extra errors per window, reference words per window
which node's text was delivered, by hash equality of deliver_normaliser.input_sha256 against each contact's stripped response
numeric shortfall by window class (the E35 diagnosis section 4 table)
the same per-window table for the sealed E35 system arm beside it (sealed, recomputed from its own outputs)
per_window_attribution.boundary: reference text is loaded in memory for alignment only (the scorer's own normaliser); the read prints and persists counts, rates, ids and hashes, never reference, transcript or delivered text

what_is_not_here: No paired estimator, no bootstrap CI as a claim, no margin, no bar, no admission, no frontier row: n = 10 calls cannot carry them (row 98 sequences the n >= 400 Earnings calibration after the SLURP main line).
